comparison.objective: Seat three boxes in keyed rail bays, versus tune and lock a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Box alignment and constrained placement versus tool engagement, counterholding, fine rotary adjustment, locking, and dynamic diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: Boxes must lie flat in separate bays within 5 mm of stops; candidate requires two ≥0.85 J stops without bottoming, hard-stop contact, rebound, overload, or drift.
comparison.reason: Constrained placement and dynamic mechanism commissioning test meaningfully different abilities.
